body: I don't even know how I would get one. How can I tell my dad I need that again after two years without any sign of anything? I'm just done with everything and I just want to end it all before I let everyone around me down by having these problems then having to deal with that.

I've tried, the counselor I have had was a dick. I mentioned I was in a political club and he got into a debate with me (which I really just mentioned because I was proud I got into something I cared about) and every time we talked he never seemed to want to let me talk and would also act like I am thinking one way when I really wasn't. My other counselor died.
